title: General Muellner's retirement-day interview on Aurora

tellings.quote: with a guy called General George Moina who was the US Air Force's head of research and development until his retirement in 1998.

plain: The writer Nick Cook says he interviewed General George Muellner, who ran research and development for the US Air Force, on the day Muellner retired in 1998, and asked him about Aurora, a secret American aircraft that was rumoured to exist. Cook tells this from his own experience and points to a documentary called Billion Dollar Secret. If the general said anything about Aurora, it would come from a man who was in a position to know about the Air Force's most secret aircraft.
